origin.origins.merling.name: Fishman
origin.origins.merling.description: Ocean-dwellers who breathe water and hit harder while wet. They cannot sleep out of water, and villagers charge them more to trade.
power.origins.water_breathing.name: Aqua-Humanoid
power.origins.water_breathing.descriptio: Gills and lungs both. You breathe water when you are in it and air when you are not.
power.origins.conduit_power_on_land.name: Conduit Power
power.origins.conduit_power_on_land.desc: While wet — submerged or under open rain — you carry the strength of a conduit with you.
